payload.title: Rebuild run: preview, Ryan approves, publish
payload.description: Runs after the code stories and after the state reset (delete_may_state.sh, Ryan runs). Workstation run from fresh origin/develop on the 52 accepted References, without --apply first. Show Ryan the proposed concepts by kind (PPY-84b0dd). Then apply and wiki sync, restoring any good concept whose page stayed down. Add confinement problem and containment problem to Security as core concepts with a noted link. Rebuild the search index.
